_note: an executed sale that reports no executed size. Shaped after the one operation on the owner's account whose payload carries no such field at all (a currency purchase, refused for a reason of its own before it ever reaches the trade rule) — this fixture puts that omission on a SHARE, where nothing else would stop it, so the refusal it earns can be pinned. Its payment says a trade happened, which is exactly why the order's 190 must not be taken for its size.
name: Продажа ценных бумаг
